metrics.data_status: Fictional company and deterministic simulated data; skill demonstration, not employment evidence.
metrics.selection_rule: Lowest 2025 holdout RMSE; selection is descriptive and should be confirmed on additional rolling windows.
metrics.retransformation: exp(predicted log revenue), no smearing correction; forecasts represent conditional median, not unbiased conditional mean.
metrics.future_macro_assumption: 2026 industrial_index increases by 0.10 per month from December2025; hypothetical input known at forecast origin, not observed 2026 values.
model_notes: Annual year-end discounting; terminal perpetuity grows 2030 unleveredFCF at2.5%.
Taxes=25% of positive taxable earnings; no tax-loss carryforwards or tax benefit for losses.
Interest uses opening debt; cash earns no interest.
D&A=9% of opening netPP&E is an illustrative calibrated aggregate depreciation driver, not an asset-vintage schedule.
No acquisitions, leases, FX, goodwill, or other assets/liabilities. All cash is treated as non-operating in the EV-to-equity bridge.
Closing cash is derived from operating/investing/financing cashflows; equity rolls from retained earnings, not a balancing plug.
2027–2030 growth assumptions are analyst scenarios, not statistical forecasts.
Validation uses observed holdout industrial_index, so the driver-model test is conditional on realized predictors; 2026 projection is conditional on assumed predictors.
Terminal value extrapolates final-year FCF without separately normalizing reinvestment to terminal growth; a steady-state return-on-invested-capital analysis is outside this illustration.

The annual forecast is the sum of monthly conditional medians, used as a planning total; it is not a formal annual conditional mean or median. HC1 addresses heteroskedasticity, not serial correlation.
